utility.notes: The City of Santa Barbara is confirmed to be within SCE's distribution service territory, per SCE's own published service-area description — independently checked rather than assumed from county location, since parts of Santa Barbara County (e.g., Santa Maria, Lompoc) are not SCE territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Central Coast Community Energy (3CE)'s own official site names Santa Barbara only as a county, not as a specific member city, and the City of Santa Barbara itself does not appear in 3CE's list of named member communities. Per the mission's rule against inferring CCA participation from county membership, generation_supplier is left null rather than assumed.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across SCE's entire distribution territory, which includes Santa Barbara/Santa Barbara County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.
